articles.title: Docking technology key to future lunar, human space missions: Isro official
articles.summary: A senior ISRO official emphasized that mastering docking technology is crucial for India's ambitious future space missions. This includes diverse operations like lunar exploration, human spaceflight, returning lunar samples to Earth, and critically, assembling India's proposed space station. Developing advanced docking capabilities is essential for establishing a sustained human presence in space and achieving India's long-term objectives in advanced space infrastructure.

articles.title: In 1944, a Vermont woman used money meant for a fur coat to buy a 150-acre farm; 20 years later she gave it to Audubon for wildlife conservation
articles.summary: In 1944, a resourceful Vermont woman opted to purchase a 150-acre farm instead of a fur coat. This generous act established a vital sanctuary, showcasing a deep commitment to environmental protection and significantly contributing to biodiversity efforts by transforming the land into a haven for various species under Audubon's stewardship.

articles.title: Su-30MKI, T-90 parts among ₹3,000-cr defence items to be indigenised
